Automatically start the API server when loading the game.
You do not need a HTTP Adapter building if you enable this option.
The port used for auto-starting the API server.
Opens a second port on all network interfaces so other devices on your LAN can reach the API. No admin privileges required.
The port exposed to your network. Access the API from other devices at http://YOUR_PC_IP:PORT/. Must be different from the local API port.
